## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `WRK-TRANSCRIBE-01` two terminal-state bullets (`status is summarizing`, `current_stage is summarize`) — interpreted as "advances past transcribe stage" because the worker chains validate→transcribe→summarize→done in one cycle when the in-memory gateways succeed. The transcription persistence + language bullets (the test's substantive contract) all match exactly. Recorded for the contract author: consider rephrasing as "status advances to summarizing or beyond" / "current_stage advances to summarize or beyond". (Same finding as run `2026-05-03T01-06-50Z`.)
- During backend bring-up the worker pool processed the seeded videos using their seed-time `next_attempt_at = now()` against the wall clock.
